svg.text: One prefill step on 4 GPUs: ranks, groups, stops
--ep 4 --cp 2 -> 2 DP replicas (engines) x 2 CP ranks · request A: 8 prompt tokens on engine 0 · commit 9bd9cf2
rank = engine_rank x 2 + cp_rank CP groups [0,1] [2,3] DP groups [0,2] [1,3] EP group [0,1,2,3]
Which processes and ranks take part?
Each engine is one DP replica. Its driver spawns one CP follower process.
What are the stops of the tour?
Each card is one stop. The pill names the group that communicates in that stop.
all-reduce MIN over DP [0,2] -> both engines prefill
engine 0: A, 8 tokens engine 1: empty prompt step (placeholder)
broadcast_tensor_dict: objects via shm, tensors via NCCL/HCCL
rank 0: t0 t1 t6 t7 rank 1: t2 t3 t4 t5 [4, H] each
KV [2 x 4] -> full [8] on both CP ranks (CPManager)
own rows to the experts on all 4 ranks and back
expert_count += received tokens; all-gather each 128 steps
hidden [8, H] on both; only rank 0 and rank 2 sample
H = hidden size (from the checkpoint). Stops 6-7 repeat in every decoder layer; the stop-8 counter grows in each MoE layer.
Engine 1 runs the same stops on a placeholder sequence.
Device numbers assume DEVICE_OFFSET = 0 on one host with 4 devices (examples/_config.py:55-63).
